info.title: Scrapix API
info.description: High-performance web crawler and search indexer API. Scrape pages, map websites, run distributed crawls, and search indexed content.

post.summary: Create a new async crawl job
Create multiple crawl jobs from a batch of configs
Create a sync crawl job (waits for completion)

get.summary: Service health endpoint — reports liveness of each component

post.summary: Map a website: sitemap-first discovery with optional BFS deep crawl
post.description:
Discovers URLs via:
1. Sitemap parsing (robots.txt → sitemap.xml → sitemap indexes)
2. Optional BFS link crawling when `depth > 0`

Each URL can be enriched with title, description (from HTML head) and
lastmod, priority, changefreq (from sitemap data) depending on `get_*` flags.

post.summary:
Scrape a single URL and return content immediately
This bypasses the job queue for instant results
Proxy search to the account's default Meilisearch engine.

CrawlConfig.description: Main configuration for a crawl job

allowed_domains.description:
Allowed domains for crawling (if empty, inferred from start_urls)
When set, only URLs from these exact domains will be crawled.
This prevents domain explosion (e.g., crawling all Wikipedia languages
when you only want en.wikipedia.org)

index_strategy.description:
Indexing strategy: how documents are written to the target index.
- `update`: add/update documents in the existing index (default)
- `replace`: index into a temporary index, then atomically swap on completion

Also accepts the legacy field name `replace_index` (bool) for backward compatibility.

index_uid.description: Meilisearch index UID (auto-generated from start_urls[0] if empty)

max_depth.description: Maximum crawl depth from start URLs

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl

meilisearch.description: Meilisearch settings (optional — resolved from account's default engine when empty)

source.description:
Source identifier for multi-tenant indexing.
When set, all documents from this crawl job are tagged with this value,
enabling per-source filtering and deletion within a shared index.
Falls back to the domain if not set.

selectors.description: Map of field name to CSS selector(s)

ExtractedSchema.description: Extracted schema data from an HTML document

oneOf.description: Extract outer HTML (including the element itself)

FeatureToggle.description: Simple feature toggle with page filters

include_pages.description: Only apply to pages matching these patterns

oneOf.description:
PDF scraping (opt-in). When enabled, the crawler fetches
`application/pdf` responses, extracts text + metadata, and indexes
them alongside HTML pages. Disabled by default.

selector.description: CSS selector relative to parent element

get_changefreq.description: Include changefreq from sitemap data (default: true)

get_lastmod.description: Include lastmod from sitemap data (default: true)

get_priority.description: Include priority from sitemap data (default: true)

get_title.description: Fetch <title> from each page's HTML head (default: true)

limit.description: Maximum number of links to return (default: 5000)

render_js.description: Render JavaScript before extracting metadata (requires Chrome/Chromium)

search.description: Filter results to URLs matching this search term

sitemap.description: Whether to use sitemaps for discovery (default: true)

PdfConfig.description:
Opt-in configuration for PDF scraping.

When `enabled = true`, PDFs are fetched (with base64-encoded transport
through the content worker), parsed for text + metadata, and indexed into
the same Meilisearch index. All other fields default to conservative values.

extract_links.description:
Reserved flag for extracting URLs embedded inside PDF text.
Currently a no-op; will be wired up in a follow-up issue.

max_size_mb.description:
Maximum PDF size in megabytes. PDFs larger than this are rejected.
When `None`, the global fetcher `max_body_size` applies.

default_crawl_delay_ms.description: Default crawl delay if not specified in robots.txt (ms)

per_domain_delay_ms.description: Minimum delay between requests to same domain (ms)

only_main_content.description: Whether to only return the main content (excludes nav, footer, etc.)
